title: Custom clearance Manager for JNPT port - G Card holder
description:
**Company Description** 
 Transcon Freight Systems Pvt Ltd is a logistics specialist providing end\-to\-end transportation solutions for diverse industry sectors. Headquartered in Mumbai, India, the company supports global operations through offices in Houston, USA, and Antwerp, Belgium. With an international footprint and local expertise, Transcon focuses on efficient, compliant, and reliable freight management. Team members collaborate across regions to deliver responsive customer service and seamless logistics experiences for clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai for a Custom Clearance Manager for JNPT port, requiring a valid G Card. The role involves overseeing day\-to\-day customs clearance operations at JNPT, including preparation and submission of documentation, coordination with customs officials, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. The Custom Clearance Manager will monitor shipment status, handle queries and escalations, and liaise with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely clearance of cargo. Responsibilities include supervising staff, optimizing processes, maintaining up\-to\-date knowledge of customs rules, and providing accurate reporting to management. The role also requires maintaining high standards of customer service and supporting training and guidance for team members.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Operations Management skills, including process oversight and coordination at JNPT port.
* Experience with Budgeting and cost control related to customs and logistics activities.
* Customer Service skills to manage client communication, issue resolution, and service quality.
* Knowledge of Vessel Operations and port procedures relevant to import/export cargo handling.
* Ability to provide Training and guidance to team members on customs processes and compliance.
* Valid G Card and hands\-on experience with Indian customs regulations and documentation.
* Attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and proficiency in using relevant IT systems and portals.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Prior experience in customs clearance or freight forwarding at JNPT or similar ports is highly beneficial.

title: Factory Manager / Plant Head – E-Waste Recycling Operations
description:
**About Us:**
 We are a fast\-growing, sustainability\-forward electronics recycling firm dedicated to the circular economy. We recover precious metals, critical raw materials, and high\-grade plastics from electronic waste, ensuring zero landfill waste. We are looking for a hands\-on, floor\-based leader to take full ownership of our state\-of\-the\-art E\-Waste Recycling Facility.
 



  





**Job Summary**
 : As the Factory Manager, you will run day\-to\-day operations of our multi\-shift e\-waste processing and material recovery facility. You will be responsible for mass\-balance optimization, maximizing yield recovery, minimizing residue, and ensuring 100% compliance with environmental and hazardous waste management rules. This is a highly operational role requiring an active shop floor presence and a deep understanding of mechanical dismantling, crushing, sorting, and refining technologies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**
 \* Production \& Capacity Management: Plan and execute multi\-shift operations across manual dismantling, mechanical shredding, optical sorting, and advanced material separation lines.
 



 \* Yield \& Mass\-Balance Optimization: Track the mass balance closely—ensuring that every metric ton of e\-waste (IT assets, household appliances, circuit boards) input is efficiently tracked through to final output (recovered copper, aluminum, plastics, e\-scrap fractions).
 



 \* Asset \& Equipment Reliability: Manage the preventive, predictive, and autonomous maintenance programs for heavy industrial equipment like industrial shredders, magnetic separators, eddy current separators, and air classifiers to ensure high OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness).
 



 \* Regulatory \& Environmental Compliance: Guarantee 100% adherence to all local environmental boards, hazardous waste disposal guidelines, pollution control norms, and labor laws. Ensure the safety of all team members through strict PPE enforcement and hazard monitoring.
 



 \* Material Inventory \& SCM Alignment: Partner with procurement and logistics teams to plan inbound scrap flows, maximize inventory turns, and ensure safe storage of components like lithium\-ion batteries and cathode ray tubes (CRTs).
 



 \* Continuous Improvement \& Lean: Implement 5S, Kaizen, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to optimize floor space, reduce processing cycle times, and maximize labor productivity.
 



 \* Team Leadership: Supervise, train, mentor, and build a high\-performance floor team consisting of shift supervisors, machine operators, and manual sorters.

title: Drydock Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 This position is responsible for the end\-to\-end planning, execution, and financial oversight of vessel drydocking and major repairs including unplanned and retrofits across a global fleet. The position serves as the primary technical link between the company, shipyards, and classification societies to ensure the dry\-dock projects are delivered safely and on schedule.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:** 
  

  

* Is familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) either directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines.
* Project Planning \& Preparation: Lead the pre\-planning phase, including pre\-docking inspections, developing detailed technical specifications (standard and non\-standard), and coordinating with vessels and vessel managers to identify specific repair needs. Making sure Seaspan vessels are docked at the most suitable and economical shipyard, at the most appropriate time and in the most cost\-effective manner. Liaising with the vessel to order spares and stores prior docking in a timely manner. Liaising with the procurement team and local agency to ensure timely and cost\-effective delivery of spares required for project execution.
* Shipyard \& Vendor Management: Review shipyard quotations for accuracy \& include missing items in the bid sheet, conduct cost/availability comparisons, and provide recommendations. Manage relationships with paint suppliers, subcontractors, and service providers.
* On\-site Supervision: With the support of Vessel Managers, oversee all stages of drydock execution at the shipyard to ensure high\-quality workmanship, adherence to timelines \& budgets, and compliance with safety and environmental standards (QSHE). Assist Vessel manager in resolving operational issues to minimize downtime and delays
* Financial Control: Along with the Vessel Manager, manage the overall repair budget, monitor project expenses in real\-time, and lead final invoice negotiations with the shipyard to identify cost\-optimization opportunities. Variations in docking scope to be documented and approvals sought from relevant stakeholders. Ensure Maximum value from allocated Dry\-dock budgets and costs saving potentials are harvested. Preparing 5\-year CAPEX rolling budget forecast for the fleet with Vessel Managers. Analyze docking costs and invoices to identify cost optimization opportunities. Follow up with service vendors for any variation in repair cost.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all work meets the requirements of classification societies, flag states, and international maritime regulations.
* Process Improvement: Improve and maintain standardized drydock procedures, software, and databases to track historical costs and performance metrics in line with industry\-wide best practices.
* Documentation \& Reporting:
+ Maintain dry\-dock records, inspection reports, and repair logs
+ Ensure document control and compliance with audit requirements


**Requirements:**
* Education: Degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Professional Experience:


* 
+ Minimum 5–8 years of experience in ship management, superintendency, or shipyard project management.
+ Proven track record of managing large\-scale drydocking projects and retrofits
+ Sailing experience as a Senior Engineer (e.g., 2nd Engineer or higher) is preferred.
+ Technical Skills:


  

  

* 
+ Proficiency in drydock management software, ERP systems, and project management tools. Technologically driven, comfortable working in a digital environment, logical process development.
+ Leveraging data and system functionality to improve decision\-making and operational performance.
+ Focus on standardization, continuous improvement, and workflow optimization across technical and operational activities.


**Core Competencies:**
* Project Management: Ability to manage complex, multi\-million\-dollar projects under tight deadlines.
* Negotiation: Assertive skills for handling shipyard contracts and final settlements.
* Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including fleet operations, marine assurance, procurement, and accounts.
* Mobility: Readiness for frequent international travel on short notice and ability to conduct physical vessel inspections.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**
* Drydocking Planning Performance: Percentage deviation from planned costs and duration.
* Budget Alignment: Preparing competitive budget. Total project spend versus allocated budget.
* Vessel Turnaround Time: Minimizing downtime and ensuring on\-time or before\-time delivery from the yard.
* Safety \& Quality: Number of health, safety, and environment (HSE) incidents or quality findings during the project.
* Corrective Actions \& Continuous Improvement: Demonstrates management commitment to continual improvement


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

title: Head of Administration and Facilities
description:
**Head of Administration \& Facilities** 




  





**The Opportunity** 




 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're building the world's most admired tattoo company.
 



 With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders.
 



 We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations.
 



 We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners.
 



 If you thrive in high\-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you.
 



 As a Administration \& Facilities Manager, you will be the CEO of your region.
 



  





**The Mandate** 




 You will own the physical and administrative backbone of every Aliens location — studios, school and headquarters alike. That means every building system staying functional, every asset tracked and maintained, every licence and lease current, every studio presentable and safe, and every location adequately staffed for the daily work of running it.
 



 You will build and run a team of your own, hire the vendors and agencies the network depends on, and hold the budget that funds all of it. When something breaks, you fix it. When something is about to break, you've usually already caught it.
 



 You will report to the Director of Operations, and you will have the authority to make every call this mandate requires.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 




 Keeping every studio and headquarters location fully functional — electrical, plumbing, air\-conditioning, access systems and the rest — with issues resolved on a clock that matches how serious they are, and repeat failures traced to their real cause instead of patched again.
 



  





 Knowing what Aliens owns, everywhere. A live record of every physical asset, serviced ahead of failure rather than after it, checked regularly against reality so nothing goes missing or is quietly falling apart.
 



  





 Keeping every location legally clear to operate — every licence, every permission, every renewal, tracked and actioned well before anything lapses. Every lease, contract and compliance document held in one place, findable in seconds.
 



 Making sure every studio has the people it needs to stay clean and presentable, every day — coverage planned properly, gaps closed the same day they appear, whether the fix comes from your own team or a trusted agency.
 



  





 Keeping headquarters running the way a workplace should — secure, stocked, orderly and ready before anyone walks in.
 



  





 Reading every studio's condition honestly and turning what needs fixing into a real plan — budgeted, scheduled, approved — then delivering that work with contractors you manage personally, on time, on budget, with the studio barely missing a beat.
 



  





 Building a vendor network Aliens can actually rely on, in every city it operates — and holding your own budget, where every rupee is tracked and real savings are found without ever touching safety or the customer experience.
 



  





 Building the team that does all of this. Hiring people who meet a real bar, developing them deliberately, and holding the standard on how Aliens works — not just what gets delivered.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 You've run facilities and administration at scale before — multiple sites, not one building. You know what a functioning building actually requires, and you can tell a good vendor's work from a mediocre one on sight.
 



  





 You are equally comfortable with two very different kinds of work, and most people are only good at one. You can read a compliance calendar and a construction quote with the same fluency you'd bring to a maintenance ticket. Systems and paperwork matter to you as much as fixing what's broken.
 



  





 You move fast under pressure. A studio without air\-conditioning on a Saturday, a licence about to lapse, a contractor running over budget — you don't wait for someone else to notice.
 



  





 You are financially disciplined. You've owned a budget before, and you know the difference between a real saving and a corner cut that shows up as a problem six months later.
 



 You build teams and hold a bar. You hire well, you coach seriously, and you don't let a values problem slide just because someone delivers.
 



  





 Experience across a multi\-location retail, hospitality or premium\-service network is a strong plus. A background that spans both hard facilities work and administrative or compliance discipline is exactly what this seat needs.
 



  





**What success looks like** 




 every studio and headquarters location runs without avoidable disruption. Breakdowns are rare, and the ones that happen are fixed fast and don't come back. Every licence is valid, every lease is tracked, and nothing has ever lapsed on your watch.

title: Engineering Leader
description:
Your Job
   

  

 As a Senior Lead – Mechanical Engineering, you will provide leadership and direction to a team of mechanical engineers, lead engineers, and designers supporting the design and execution of engineered\-to\-order products within John Zink's global engineering organization. You will be responsible for building team capability, driving engineering excellence, improving execution discipline, and partnering with global stakeholders to deliver innovative, safe, reliable, and cost\-effective solutions that create long\-term value for customers and the business.
   

  

 Our Team
   

  

 You will be part of the John Zink global engineering organization supporting combustion and emissions\-control technologies across multiple industries. Our team collaborates closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, supply chain, quality, and business stakeholders worldwide to deliver industry\-leading solutions while fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and value creation.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

 Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and designers while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
   

  

 Build organizational capability by identifying development opportunities, creating growth plans, and strengthening leadership readiness within the team.
   

  

 Partner with global stakeholders to drive successful execution of complex engineering projects and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 Improve engineering effectiveness through standardization, knowledge sharing, quality processes, and continuous improvement efforts.
   

  

 Promote engineering solutions that prioritize safety, manufacturability, reliability, customer value, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Influence cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to achieve business objectives and deliver superior outcomes.
   

  

 Support transformation initiatives that enhance engineering productivity, innovation, and design quality.
   

  

 Champion Koch's values and Principle Based Management™ by empowering individuals, encouraging constructive challenge, and driving value creation.
   

  

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
   

  

 14\+ years of experience in mechanical engineering, equipment design, product engineering, or engineered\-to\-order project execution.
   

  

 5\+ years of experience leading engineers, designers, technical teams, or complex engineering workstreams.
   

  

 Experience developing talent, improving team performance, and influencing outcomes across cross\-functional organizations.
   

  

 Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, engineering documentation, fabrication processes, and design\-for\-manufacturing practices.
   

  

 Experience collaborating with global stakeholders in a matrixed engineering environment.
   

  

 Strong communication, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.
   

  

 What Will Put You Ahead
   

  

 Experience in combustion systems, emissions\-control technologies, oil \& gas, petrochemical, process equipment, pressure equipment, or heavy industrial industries.
   

  

 Familiarity with burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor control systems, or similar engineered equipment.
   

  

 Experience leading engineering transformation, standardization, automation, digital engineering, or process improvement initiatives.
   

  

 Advanced degree (Master's, MBA, or equivalent) or formal leadership development training.
   

  

 Experience working across global engineering centers and manufacturing locations.
   

  

 Demonstrated success in developing future technical and people leaders.
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 John Zink, a Koch Engineered Solutions (KES) business, is a global combustion and emissions\-control partner delivering engineered solutions such as industrial burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor control systems, and related services. The organization combines deep technical expertise, proven execution capability, and a culture of innovation to help customers solve complex industrial challenges safely, reliably, and efficiently.
   

  

 At Koch, employees are empowered to apply Principled Entrepreneurship™, challenge the status quo, and create long\-term value for customers, the company, and themselves. This role will be based in Navi Mumbai and will support global engineering and design execution across the John Zink Combustion business.

description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
   

  

 Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
   

  

 Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
   

  

 Systra India's design business line is the leading design team for metros, highways, special bridges, Urban Planning and water projects in India. The team has designed over 900 kms of viaduct \& Bridges along with 43 kms of tunnels and 82 underground stations, 345 Elevated \& at\-grade Stations, 19 Depots besides 300 plus stations being designed currently. The team has also completed 3,165 km of highways detail design projects and 22,506 km of design/ feasibility projects. The team has also worked on detailed design for Drainage and Utilities, design of WTP and STP etc.
   

  

 We are also very proud to have designed the first monopile in India for the Mumbai Coastal Road project. We have the distinction of designing the fastest implemented metro project in the country with Lucknow and now have broken the record in Kanpur Metro. Apart from Indian projects the team also provides design services to projects as far as Philippines in the east to Columbia in the West.
   

  

 We are also conversant with BIM (Building Information Modelling) which enhances all stages of the infrastructure life cycle, from design to construction and maintenance, which is why we integrate it into our projects and offer it to our clients. Our design team has extensive exposure to both domestic and international markets, contracts, codes and specification.
   

  

 We are seeking applications for the position of Team Leader for the upcoming Urban Planning project.

* Lead and manage the overall project execution and delivery.
* Provide strategic and technical guidance to the project team.
* Review land\-use analyses, demographic assessments, socio\-economic studies, and infrastructure planning reports.
* Ensure integration of sustainable and resilient urban development principles.
* Manage multidisciplinary experts including planners, architects, engineers, GIS specialists, environmental experts, and economists.
* Review all reports, presentations, GIS outputs, and planning documents before submission.
* Ensure adherence to national, state, and local planning regulations and guidelines.

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in urban planning, town planning, regional planning, city development, infrastructure planning, or related fields.
* Graduate Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Planning, or Geography. Post Graduate Degree in Urban Planning, Town Planning, City Planning, Regional Planning, or equivalent.
* Expertise in master planning, regional planning, and infrastructure planning.
* Excellent project management and leadership skills.


 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!
   

  

 Workplace Type
   

  

 On\-site

 Cross\-functional Collaboration

title: Senior Manager – Campus Operations & Student Services
description:
**Role Purpose** 




 The Senior Manager \- Central Administration, Housing \& Faculty Services will be responsible for providing central oversight, governance and service coordination for workplace administration, student housing and faculty services across Emeritus in India.
 



 The role will act as a central governance, coordination and performance\-oversight interface between students, parents, faculty, campus teams, service providers and internal functions, ensuring that operational services delivered by campuses and external service providers meet agreed standards, contractual commitments and stakeholder expectations.
 



 The role will also contribute to commercial oversight, service performance, operational governance and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on student/faculty experience and institutional reputation.
 



 For student housing specifically, the accommodation operator remains accountable for day\-to\-day delivery; this role owns the central governance and interface layer – service quality, SLA adherence, escalation and commercial reconciliation – rather than direct hostel administration.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Workplace Administration, Facilities \& Coworking Management (\~40%)** 



* Provide central oversight of workplace administration and facilities services across Emeritus locations, including conventional offices and managed/coworking spaces.
* Manage and maintain a central repository of coworking/workplace agreements, commercial terms, service inclusions, utilisation provisions, renewal dates and key obligations.
* Coordinate with coworking/workplace providers on day\-to\-day service issues, maintenance, housekeeping, security, access, amenities and other workplace requirements.
* Monitor billing, utilisation and contractual charges against agreed commercial terms and coordinate with Finance/Procurement for reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.
* Track contract renewals, notice periods, rate revisions and changes in business requirements, ensuring timely review and decision\-making with relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with workplace/coworking providers to monitor compliance with applicable health, safety, statutory and emergency\-readiness requirements for spaces occupied by Emeritus employees.
* Monitor employee experience across workplace locations and coworking facilities, including workplace readiness, access, amenities, service quality and issue resolution.
* Act as the central point of coordination with workplace/coworking providers and internal stakeholders for escalations and service improvements.
* Coordinate with coworking/managed\-workplace providers to monitor delivery of agreed workplace services, facilities, access, safety and amenities against contractual commitments, with issues escalated and tracked through closure.
* Establish common standards, reporting and governance for distributed workplace arrangements while allowing for location\-specific operating models.



**2\. Student Housing \- Oversight \& Service Governance (\~40%)** 



* Act as the central coordination point between accommodation operators, campus administration, students and parents.
* Monitor and govern delivery of contracted services against agreed SLAs, service standards and student expectations, and drive corrective action with the accommodation operator where gaps are identified.
* Monitor accommodation experience, complaints, NPS, service quality, hygiene, food, security and maintenance standards across operators.
* Track occupancy and unsold inventory and work with relevant stakeholders to identify operational and commercial implications.
* Validate services delivered against contractual commitments and costs incurred, including service\-vs\-cost reconciliation and identification of recurring gaps or leakage.
* Drive resolution of escalations and recurring issues with operators and campus teams, and drive vendor accountability through corrective actions, escalation and contractual governance.
* Establish standard operating processes, reporting mechanisms and governance for student housing.
* Ensure housing service quality supports student wellbeing, university reputation and the overall student experience.



**3\. Faculty Engagement for Partner Universities (\~20%)** 



* Serve as the central, first point of operational engagement for faculty from partner universities, particularly international faculty.
* Coordinate the faculty service journey in partnership with HR, Travel, campus teams and relevant service providers, including mobility and accommodation support, day\-to\-day assistance, issue resolution and escalation management.
* Work closely with campus administration and service providers to ensure timely and consistent support.
* Proactively identify, coordinate and drive resolution of faculty service issues and escalations with the relevant functional teams and service providers.
* Develop a structured faculty\-service framework to ensure a consistent experience across campuses.



**4\. Central Operations \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Develop and implement common SOPs, service standards, KPIs, dashboards and escalation mechanisms.
* Work closely with Campus Operations, HR, Procurement, Finance, IT, Real Estate and other central functions.
* Support operational readiness for new campuses and evolving business requirements.
* Identify recurring operational issues and develop scalable solutions rather than location\-specific fixes.
* Represent Central Operations in discussions with key vendors and institutional stakeholders.



**5\. Commercial \& Performance Governance** 



* Apply the full commercial chain to every managed service: service delivered → contractual commitment → utilisation → cost incurred → commercial leakage → business impact.
* Validate service delivery, utilisation and billing against approved contractual terms and support Procurement/Finance in identifying commercial discrepancies, leakage and optimisation opportunities.
* Support commercial reviews related to housing and other managed services.
* Monitor contracted versus actual service delivery and associated costs.
* For housing specifically, apply enough commercial acumen to assess unsold inventory, reconciliation and service credits/gaps, while Procurement remains the commercial/contracting specialist.
* Review workplace/coworking utilisation, contracted services, billing and commercial terms, and identify opportunities for optimisation based on business requirements and employee utilisation.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, service improvement and better utilisation.
* Prepare periodic performance reviews covering service quality, complaints, NPS, costs, SLA performance and key risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals and governance are maintained.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Multi\-stakeholder management – students, parents, faculty, universities, campus teams and vendors.
* Service governance and vendor management.
* Student/faculty experience orientation.
* Commercial and analytical acumen.
* Problem\-solving and escalation management.
* Independent ownership – able to operate without close supervision and drive outcomes end to end.
* Process and SOP development.
* Multi\-location operations experience.
* Executive\-level communication and stakeholder influence.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and in a fast\-growing, scaling, multi\-campus environment.



  





**Experience \& Qualification** 



* 10–14 years of relevant professional experience, preferably across administration, facilities, hospitality, student accommodation, workplace or higher\-education operations.
* Experience managing external service providers and customer\-facing operations.
* Experience in multi\-location or distributed operations is preferred.
* Exposure to international faculty, students, residential services or higher education would be an advantage.
* Graduate degree in any relevant discipline; professional qualifications in Facilities Management, Hospitality, Administration or related areas would be an advantage.



  





**Success Measures** 



* Student housing service quality and NPS
* Timely closure and reduction of recurring complaints
* SLA and vendor performance
* Service delivery versus contractual commitments
* Cost/service reconciliation and commercial optimisation
* Faculty experience and issue\-resolution effectiveness
* Office operational performance
* Workplace/coworking service performance, commercial compliance and employee experience
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Readiness and scalability of central operating processes
* Successful support for new campus launches and operational expansion

title: Sr. Operations manager
description:
**Company Description:** 
 TrueNorth DMC is a destination management company specializing in comprehensive ground handling and destination services across the United States, Canada, and North America.
 



 We work with international tour operators, travel agencies, corporate groups, and travel partners to deliver seamless FIT, Group, MICE, and customized travel experiences. Our services include hotels, transportation, sightseeing, attractions, restaurants, guides, airport transfers, group movements, and complete destination management.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Operations Manager** 
 to lead and strengthen our U.S. operations team.
 


**Position Overview** 

 The Senior Operations Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end execution of group tours, FIT bookings, MICE movements, and customized travel programs throughout the United States.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring strong destination knowledge, supplier relationships, operational planning, problem\-solving abilities, and the ability to manage multiple groups simultaneously.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience working with a
 **DMC, receptive tour operator, inbound tour operator, or travel company handling U.S. ground operations** 
 .
 


**Key Responsibilities** 
 Tour \& Group Operations
 * Manage complete ground operations for leisure groups, FIT travelers, MICE groups, and customized programs across the United States.
* Review finalized itineraries and ensure all operational components are booked and reconfirmed.
* Coordinate hotels, transportation, restaurants, attractions, guides, airport transfers, activities, and other ground services.
* Prepare detailed operational files, movement sheets, vouchers, rooming lists, manifests, and supplier confirmations.
* Monitor groups from arrival through departure and ensure smooth execution throughout the tour.
* Manage multiple departures and operational files simultaneously.
* Ensure all services are delivered according to the confirmed itinerary, quality standards, and client expectations.


 Supplier \& Vendor Management
 * Develop and maintain strong relationships with hotels, transportation companies, restaurants, attractions, guides, and local suppliers.
* Negotiate competitive rates, terms, cancellation policies, and operational conditions.
* Source new suppliers and alternatives in major U.S. destinations.
* Maintain an updated supplier database and preferred vendor network.
* Monitor supplier performance and resolve service\-related issues.
* Ensure suppliers receive accurate passenger counts, timings, manifests, and service requirements.


 Transportation \& Logistics
 * Coordinate coaches, minibuses, Sprinter vans, SUVs, airport transfers, and other transportation requirements.
* Manage driver schedules, DOT\-related operational considerations, routing, parking, permits, and group movement logistics.
* Coordinate airport arrivals and departures, including meet\-and\-greet services.
* Plan complex multi\-city movements while maintaining realistic travel times and operational efficiency.
* Handle last\-minute transportation changes, delays, breakdowns, and other operational issues.


 Hotel \& Accommodation Operations
 * Coordinate hotel reservations, rooming lists, group allocations, special requests, and payment deadlines.
* Work directly with hotel sales and operations teams for group arrivals and departures.
* Monitor attrition, cancellation deadlines, deposits, and final payment schedules.
* Reconfirm group arrangements before arrival and ensure smooth check\-in and check\-out procedures.


 Client \& Partner Coordination
 * Communicate with international tour operators, travel agencies, and B2B partners regarding operational requirements.
* Review itineraries before operation and identify potential logistical challenges.
* Provide timely operational updates to clients and internal teams.
* Coordinate special requirements including dietary preferences, accessibility needs, VIP travelers, senior travelers, and special occasions.
* Build long\-term relationships with B2B partners through reliable execution and proactive communication.


 Team Leadership
 * Lead, train, and supervise the operations team.
* Allocate files and responsibilities based on workload and destination expertise.
* Establish operational processes, checklists, and quality\-control procedures.
* Conduct pre\-departure reviews for major groups.
* Monitor team performance, response times, accuracy, and service standards.
* Support team members during high\-volume periods and complex operations.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, and exceptional customer service.


 On\-Tour Support \& Problem Resolution
 * Serve as a senior escalation point for operational issues.
* Handle last\-minute changes, flight disruptions, supplier cancellations, passenger emergencies, and service recovery.
* Coordinate solutions quickly while minimizing financial and operational impact.
* Maintain communication with tour managers, drivers, suppliers, and clients during active departures.
* Participate in after\-hours operational support when required for active groups.


 Cost Control \& Operational Profitability
 * Review supplier costs and ensure services remain within approved budgets.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and margins without compromising service quality.
* Verify supplier invoices against confirmed services and contracted rates.
* Work closely with the contracting, sales, and finance teams regarding costing and supplier payments.
* Monitor operational expenses and prevent avoidable additional charges.


 Preferred Experience
 * 5\+ years of experience in travel operations, preferably within a
 **U.S. DMC, receptive operator, inbound tour operator, group tour operator, or destination management company** 
 .
* 2\+ years of experience managing or supervising an operations team preferred.
* Strong knowledge of major U.S. destinations and tourism circuits.
* Experience managing multi\-city group tours within the United States.
* Strong understanding of hotels, motorcoach operations, attractions, restaurants, guides, and group logistics.
* Experience handling international travelers and overseas B2B travel partners.
* Experience with MICE, corporate groups, incentive travel, and large leisure groups is an advantage.


 Key Skills
 * Excellent operational planning and organizational skills
* Strong leadership and team\-management abilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong negotiation and vendor\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple groups and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to remain calm and solution\-oriented during operational disruptions
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, CRM, and travel operations systems
* Understanding of tour costing and operational margins
* Strong geographic knowledge of the United States


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who thinks beyond simply making reservations.
 



 The right candidate understands the complete journey of a group, anticipates operational challenges before they happen, maintains strong supplier relationships, takes ownership of every file, and ensures that our clients receive consistently reliable service.
 



 You should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where multiple groups may be traveling across different U.S. destinations at the same time.
 


 Why Join TrueNorth DMC?
 
 At TrueNorth DMC, you will have the opportunity to play a key leadership role in building and expanding a growing North American destination management company.
 


* You will work directly with international travel partners, develop supplier networks across major destinations, lead operational teams, and help establish the systems and service standards required to scale our U.S. and North American operations.

title: KYC Manager
description:

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain regulatory and operational requirements clearly.

 2\. Team Management \& Leadership
 * Lead, manage, and motivate physiotherapists and centre staff.
* Plan staff schedules, therapist allocation, leaves, and daily responsibilities.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.
* Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and development of team members.
* Monitor individual and team productivity.
* Build a positive, accountable, and collaborative centre culture.
* Identify performance gaps and work with team members to improve them.


 3\. Clinical Quality \& Patient Care
 * Ensure patients receive high\-quality, ethical, and evidence\-based physiotherapy care.
* Monitor adherence to clinical protocols and treatment standards.
* Work closely with physiotherapists to improve assessment, treatment planning, documentation, and patient outcomes.
* Review patient feedback and identify opportunities to improve the patient experience.
* Escalate and appropriately manage complex patient concerns.
* Ensure patient records, treatment plans, progress reports, and other documentation are maintained accurately.


 4\. Patient Experience \& Retention
 * Ensure every patient receives a professional, welcoming, and personalised experience.
* Monitor patient satisfaction and feedback.
* Track treatment adherence, follow\-ups, and missed appointments.
* Work with the clinical team to improve treatment\-plan adherence and patient engagement.
* Build strong relationships with patients and address concerns promptly.
* Support long\-term patient retention through quality care and effective communication.


 5\. Centre Growth \& Business Performance
 * Take ownership of centre\-level performance and growth targets.
* Monitor key metrics such as:
* New patient enquiries
* Assessments/consultations
* Conversion to treatment plans
* Treatment\-plan adherence
* Patient retention
* Follow\-up rates
* Therapist utilisation
* Revenue and collections
* Patient satisfaction
* Identify opportunities to increase centre utilisation and patient footfall.
* Work with the central marketing/business team on local growth initiatives.
* Develop relationships with doctors, hospitals, corporates, gyms, sports organisations, and other relevant referral partners where appropriate.
* Monitor centre performance against agreed targets and prepare regular reports for management.


 6\. Sales \& Consultation Support
 * Ensure prospective patients receive accurate information about FlexifyMe's services and treatment approach.
* Support the team in converting appropriate consultations into structured treatment plans without compromising clinical ethics.
* Help therapists communicate treatment plans, expected timelines, follow\-ups, and patient responsibilities effectively.
* Track and address reasons for treatment drop\-offs.


 7\. Reporting \& Performance Management
 * Maintain accurate daily, weekly, and monthly centre reports.
* Analyse centre performance and identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct regular reviews of operational and business KPIs.
* Share insights and action plans with the management team.
* Ensure timely completion of administrative and compliance\-related activities.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 
 The Centre Head will be evaluated on a combination of
 **patient care, people, operations, and business performance** 
 , including:
 


* Centre revenue and achievement of agreed targets
* New patient acquisition
* Consultation\-to\-treatment conversion
* Patient retention and treatment\-plan adherence
* Patient satisfaction and feedback
* Therapist utilisation and productivity
* Team attendance and performance
* Operational efficiency
* Clinical documentation and protocol adherence
* Centre hygiene, safety, and compliance
* Staff engagement and retention


 Required Qualifications \& Experience
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physiotherapy, Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, or a related field.
* **2–4\+ years of professional experience** 
 , preferably including experience in a physiotherapy clinic, rehabilitation centre, hospital, healthcare organisation, or similar setting.
* Prior experience managing a team or healthcare centre is preferred.
* Strong understanding of physiotherapy/rehabilitation services is an advantage.
* Experience with MSK, orthopaedic, sports, or chronic pain rehabilitation is desirable.


 Required Skills
 * Strong leadership and people\-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong patient\-handling and relationship\-management abilities.
* Good organisational and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Commercial and business awareness.
* Data\-driven approach to performance management.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to coach and motivate clinical teams.
* Professional, empathetic, and patient\-first approach.
* Comfortable working with targets, KPIs, and performance metrics.


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who can think like an
 **owner of the centre** 
 — someone who can ensure that:
 



**Patients receive excellent care → therapists perform at their best → operations run smoothly → patients stay engaged with their treatment → the centre grows sustainably.** 




 The Centre Head should be capable of being the
 **primary point of ownership for the centre** 
 , while working closely with the clinical, operations, marketing, and management teams.
 


 Why Join FlexifyMe?
 * Opportunity to take leadership ownership of a growing physiotherapy centre.
* Work with a multidisciplinary and performance\-oriented healthcare team.
* Opportunity to contribute to clinical and operational excellence.
* Professional growth and leadership development opportunities.
* Exposure to both healthcare delivery and centre management.
* Opportunity to be part of a growing physiotherapy and pain\-management organisation.

title: Team Lead - Fraud Prevention Investigation
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
   

  

 We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
   

  

 Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
   

  

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Fraud Prevention Investigations Team Leader’s main responsibility is to have close interaction with the members of the Fraud Prevention Investigations team in order to guide, motivate and inspire them to reach high performance and achieve department goals.
   

  

 Responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to, providing assistance and guidelines when such are required, sharing knowledge and educating team members on correct approach \& routines. In parallel Team Leader \- Fraud Prevention Investigations is responsible to monitor the volume of the daily inflow on team’s tasks and take appropriate actions to secure timely and accurate management via a data driven approach.
   

  

 An important aspect of a team leader's role is to identify and report tendencies, recommend proposals \& ideas related to areas of improvement, as well as share received feedback and team's ‘’pulse’’ to team managers.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Coordinate daily operations of the Fraud Prevention Investigations Specialists
* Follow up on team members’ daily/monthly schedule (working hours, assigned tasks, etc) and ensure efficiency
* Manage team cohesion across time zones and hybrid work environments
* Conduct fraud investigations on transactions of high risk as per daily operational needs
* Lead, mentor, and motivate team members, keeping them focused and on track to achieve departmental goals and objectives
* Provide guidance and coaching to team members to enhance their skills in fraud detection techniques \& investigation methods
* Provide trainings based on team members needs (newcomers, refresher courses) and make sure development plan is communicated accordingly
* Collect and transmit team members' feedback
* Monitor/Produce reports for team’s performance, as well as any other ad hoc need
* Communicate processes and instructions to team members
* Resolve and manage (or further escalate) issues which cannot be resolved by the team
* Detect and report timely irregularities \& tendencies which may have an overall impact on the department’s operations
* Propose/Create \& Update potential changes/improvements in current processes \& tools
* Stay up to date with the latest online fraud trends, practices and tools
* Ensure confidentiality of all information collected


 Job Requirement
   

  

* Proven experience of at least 18 months in current role at ETG
* Proven experience of at least 1 year in fraud department or leadership role
* Studies in Statistics / Technology / Engineering / Mathmatics will be considered a plus
* Fluency in English (verbal and written). Other languages will be considered an asset
* Data driven thinking along with strong critical, analytical and investigation skills
* Ability to act proactively, take initiatives and pay attention to detail
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, including team building, coaching, and performance management
* Team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills including the ability to interact with stakeholders
* Work independently, meet tight deadlines and navigate multiple systems and processes
* High level of responsibility \& integrity
* Discretion in dealing with confidential information
* Computer literacy


 Thorough On Boarding Process
   

  

 We are building a stellar onboarding adventure just for you, spanning your first 120 days, including access to learning resources, Q\&A sessions with our CEO and a buddy program.
   

  

 Competitive Benefits
   

  

 We pay fairly and align compensation with your role's impact on the company. Referral bonus, pension and insurances are also applicable, with some variations across our locations.
   

  

 Wellbeing \& Community
   

  

 In order to be the best version of you every day, you need an environment that provides for your wellbeing. From breakfast \& good coffee to start your day to healthcare, employee assistance plans and team bonding events we've got you covered!
   

  

 Opportunities for Development
   

  

 You will find extensive learning opportunities, team training and workshops connected to your role as well as guidance from renown leaders, all provided in a fast pace environment with flat hierarchies.
   

  

 Hybrid Work
   

  

 We want you to enjoy the best of all worlds and we know that doesn't always mean working at the office. We have a hybrid policy, including working from anywhere 2 weeks every year.
   

  

 Diversity disclaimer
   

  

*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* 
*During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti\-discrimination law or regulation.*

* Liaising with service and spares delivery teams to coordinate delivery of in stock inventory from warehouses; assisting with quarterly stock audits.



**Build a strong \& reliable vendor base — with backup suppliers for every critical item and a live performance scorecard for our top 20 vendors.** 




**Build a vendor base that is reliable, benchmarked, and never single\-threaded on critical items.** 



* Ensure to have a strong database of reliable vendors; analyze the performance of vendors on the basis of their on time and quality deliveries, payment terms, quotations and Source and onboard new vendors per category requirements.

* Maintain vendor performance scorecard for top 20 (delivery, quality, responsiveness, pricing)
* Run vendor verification as per company guidelines. Develop and strengthen the vendor onboarding process.
* Reviewing vendor’s credit ratings and negotiating credit terms, prices.



**Achieve minimum 5% YoY cost savings on tracked spend with 100% adherence to 3\-quote discipline on non\-standard orders** 



* Ensure we have at least 3 comparative quotations from different vendors for each requirement and we perform a cost and quality analysis for each requirement before placing orders; with an aim of achieving maximum cost savings without compromising on quality and delivery timelines.
* Assisting accounts team for accurate reporting of forecasted payment outflows and expected expenses; while also ensuring that all expenses are within budgeted ranges. Highlighting and taking appropriate deviation approvals on time before proceeding with any vendor commitments. Achieving Procurement Efficiency, Budgetary Control and Compliance Controls.
* Protect throughput — ensure to have no leakage between quoted and actual cost for any project backed purchase.
* Cost Optimization \- Ensure best rates through comparative analysis and negotiations. Avail Early Payment Discounts for cost reductions.

**Knowledge/Skills/Behaviors**

* Understanding of marine / oil \& gas / heavy engineering spares and their sourcing landscape
* Awareness of FTWZ / warehouse operations and import documentation
* Working knowledge of Incoterms, HSN codes, and GST implications on procurement



  





 Skills (Functional and Non\-Technical):

 Sunday and Monday
 



  





**About CollegePass** 




 CollegePass provides personalised admissions advising and academic support to students pursuing competitive international university pathways. We are expanding our academic tutoring service for students studying international curricula, particularly IBDP, IB MYP and IGCSE.
 



  





**Role overview** 




 We are looking for an organised and academically aware
 **IB \& IGCSE Tutoring Operations Manager** 
 to manage the complete tutoring experience for students, parents and tutors.
 



 This is an
 **academic\-operations and service\-delivery role** 
 , not a sales or admissions\-consulting position. You will recruit and evaluate tutors, match students with suitable teachers, manage schedules, monitor lesson quality, track student progress and resolve parent or tutor concerns.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Recruit, screen, evaluate and onboard tutors across IBDP, IB MYP, Cambridge IGCSE, Pearson Edexcel International GCSE and, where relevant, AS/A Levels.
* Conduct initial tutor interviews and coordinate or evaluate demo lessons.
* Match students with tutors based on curriculum, examination board, subject, level, learning needs, personality, time zone and availability.
* Confirm whether students follow Cambridge or Edexcel specifications and identify the correct subject level or paper before assigning tutors.
* Manage trial lessons, regular schedules, rescheduling, tutor substitutions and cancellations.
* Track attendance, lesson completion, homework, learning plans and student progress.
* Ensure tutors submit lesson notes and progress updates accurately and on time.
* Monitor teaching quality through lesson observations and feedback from students and parents.
* Identify underperforming tutors and implement improvement plans or replacements.
* Communicate professionally with parents regarding schedules, progress, concerns and corrective action.
* Resolve urgent tutor cancellations and parent escalations calmly and promptly.
* Maintain complete records in Google Sheets, calendars, CRM and internal systems.
* Coordinate lessons across Indian and international time zones where required.
* Maintain a reliable tutor pipeline across Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Business Management, English and other international\-curriculum subjects.
* Track operational metrics including tutor attendance, trial\-to\-regular conversion, student retention, tutor utilisation, parent satisfaction and issue\-resolution time.



  





**Candidate requirements** 



* 3–8 years of experience in tutoring operations, academic coordination, international\-school operations, EdTech operations or education\-service delivery.
* Experience managing tutors, teachers, students or academic schedules.
* Working knowledge of at least two of the following: IBDP, IB MYP, Cambridge IGCSE, Pearson Edexcel International GCSE or AS/A Levels.
* Direct IB experience is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of IB HL/SL distinctions and the differences between Cambridge and Edexcel specifications.
* Strong spoken and written English.
* Excellent organisation, follow\-up and problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable communicating with parents, students and tutors through calls, WhatsApp, email and video meetings.
* Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Calendar, CRMs and online learning platforms.
* Able to manage urgent schedule changes and service concerns during working hours.
* Willing to remain hands\-on and personally accountable for daily tutoring operations.



  





**Preferred experience** 



* Previous experience with an IB school, international tutoring company, premium education service or EdTech organisation.
* Existing network of IB or IGCSE tutors.
* Experience evaluating tutor demo lessons.
* Familiarity with internal assessments, school assessments, mock examinations, predicted grades and final examinations.



  





**What success looks like** 



* Students are matched with suitable tutors quickly and accurately.
* Tutor attendance and lesson\-note compliance remain consistently high.
* Parents receive timely and professional communication.
* Academic or scheduling concerns are resolved before they affect retention.
* CollegePass maintains a dependable pipeline of subject\-qualified tutors.
* Every active student has a clear schedule, tutor, learning plan and progress record.



  





**Application process** 




 Complete the CollegePass application form. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a live tutor\-evaluation and scheduling exercise.

 Full\-time

 Management

 We are looking for a hands\-on Resort Operations Manager to manage and supervise the day\-to\-day operations of our holiday homes and clubhouses across six locations.

* Occupancy and hospitality revenue
* Cleanliness and property\-maintenance standards
* Guest complaint\-resolution time
* Operating cost and wastage control
* Staff attendance, discipline and retention
* Preventive\-maintenance completion

title: Regional Logistics In charge (RLI)
description:
**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Supply Chain
 



 Positions : 2
 



 Location : Mumbai
 



**Role Purpose** 




 The Regional Logistics In charge is responsible for end\-to\-end regional logistics execution, ensuring seamless C\&F operations, inventory integrity, on\-time customer service, optimized secondary transportation costs, statutory compliance, and audit readiness across depots and distributors. The role plays a critical link between plants, depots, sales teams, and transporters, especially during peak beverage seasons.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. C\&F /CFA KPI Monitoring** 



* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of C\&F agents across the region to ensure compliance with company SOPs.
* Ensure inbound receipts, storage, dispatches, manpower deployment, and asset utilization are as per agreed SLAs.
* Drive productivity, cost control, and operational discipline at all C\&F locations.
* Review and finalize C\&F billing, validate claims, and ensure adherence to contractual terms.



  





**2\. Inventory Management \& Controls** 



* Maintain optimal inventory levels at C\&Fs and redistribution points aligned with sales forecasts and plant supply plans.
* Monitor stock ageing, slow/non\-moving inventory, damages, expiries, and obsolescence.
* Ensure 100% inventory accuracy through cycle counts and periodic physical stock audits.
* Investigate and close stock variances, shortages, and excesses with root cause analysis and corrective actions.



  





**3\. Order Management \& Customer Service** 



* Ensure order processing, allocation, and dispatch are executed within defined TATs.
* Coordinate with Sales, Planning, and C\&Fs to manage order prioritization during peak demand.
* Track order fill rate, OTIF (On\-Time\-In\-Full), delivery adherence, and resolve customer complaints.
* Drive service improvements through exception management and proactive communication.



  





**4\. Secondary Transportation \& Freight Negotiation** 



* Manage secondary freight operations from C\&F to distributors/retailers.
* Lead transporter onboarding, lane finalization, and rate negotiations to optimize cost\-to\-serve.
* Monitor freight adherence, vehicle placement, turnaround time, and delivery performance.
* Control freight costs through route optimization, load consolidation, and productivity improvements.



  





**5\. Compliance, Audits \& Governance** 



* Ensure compliance with statutory, taxation, food safety, and internal control requirements.
* Conduct regular audits of C\&Fs, transporters, and logistics processes.
* Close audit observations within timelines and implements preventive controls.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, safety norms, and risk management practices.



  





**6\. Supply Network Design \& Optimization** 



* Support regional supply network design including location, addition, consolidation, or rationalization of C\&Fs and redistribution points based on volume growth, service requirements, and cost\-to\-serve analysis.
* Evaluate depot\-to\-market reach, delivery lead times, and freight economics to improve network efficiency and responsiveness.
* Lead end\-to\-end onboarding of new C\&F agents, including site evaluation, commercial finalization, system readiness, and SOP deployment.
* Assess infrastructure adequacy (warehouse space, handling equipment, manpower, IT systems, safety norms) before onboarding.
* Ensure seamless transition during C\&F changeovers, including inventory handover, transporter alignment, and customer communication.
* Train C\&F teams on company processes, compliance requirements, inventory controls, and service standards.
* Periodically evaluate C\&F performance and capability; recommend continuation, expansion, or replacement based on SLA adherence and audit outcomes.



  





**7\. Performance Management \& Reporting** 



* Track and publish regional logistics KPIs including:
* Inventory accuracy \& DOH
* OTIF / service level
* Secondary freight cost per case
* C\&F productivity \& compliance
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve service, cost, and control.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 



* Graduate in Commerce / Engineering / Logistics / Supply Chain
* MBA / PG Diploma in Supply Chain (preferred)



**Experience** 



* 8–15 years of experience in logistics / distribution operations within FMCG or beverage companies
* Strong exposure to C\&F operations, secondary logistics, inventory controls, and audits
* Prior experience handling high\-volume, seasonal distribution environments is critical



  





**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of FMCG / Beverage distribution dynamics
* Hands\-on experience with WMS / ERP (SAP preferred)
* Data\-driven, detail\-oriented, and operationally strong
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple locations and pressure situations during peak season



  





 Interested candidate please mail candidates at :
 



 prajjwal.mukhopadhyay@parleagro.com

**What you'll be doing:**
 Team Supervision \& Leadership
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and evaluate a team of OTC Billing Specialists.
* Set daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets (KPIs) for the billing team and monitor progress.
* Standardize training materials and ensure the team is cross\-trained on various OTC workflows and customer portfolios.


 Order\-to\-Cash Billing Operations
   

  

* Oversee the end\-to\-end billing workflow, ensuring sales orders, contracts, and shipping/delivery data are accurately converted into customer invoices.
* Review and approve high\-value invoices, credit/debit memos, manual adjustments, and cancellations.
* Ensure tight integration and communication between the billing team, Order Management (Customer Service), Credit/Collections, and Cash Application.
* Manage customer\-specific billing requirements


 Dispute Management \& Customer Relations
   

  

* Serve as the escalation point for complex billing disputes, price discrepancies, and tax issues.
* Work closely with the Collections to resolve root causes of billing\-related payment delays, minimizing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
* Ensure timely resolution of customer queries regarding invoices and statements.


 Compliance, Reporting \& Month\-End Close
   

  

* Oversee month\-end close activities for the billing ledger, ensuring all revenue\-generating activities for the period are billed and posted.
* Perform reconciliations between order management systems and the general ledger (GL).
* Generate and present key OTC metrics (e.g., Billing Accuracy, Invoice Cycle Time, Unbilled Revenue, Credit Memo volume).
* Maintain strict adherence to internal controls (SOX compliance) regarding revenue recognition, pricing approvals, and credit memo issuance.

 , our Parent company, is India’s leading luxury home developer, creating bespoke villas that blend heritage with contemporary sophistication.

**Team \& People Management** 



* Manage, mentor, corporate, warehouse and rider teams across Mumbai and Goa, ensuring adequate coverage and timely deliveries.
* Set clear performance expectations, conduct regular reviews, build a culture of accountability.
* Identify and resolve day\-to\-day issues within the team — from workload and scheduling conflicts to performance gaps — before they escalate.



  





**Vendor Management** 



* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage vendors across all procurement categories (F\&B supplies, linen, guest amenities, maintenance, housekeeping supplies, etc.).
* Negotiate pricing, contracts, and service\-level agreements to ensure quality and cost\-efficiency.
* Build and maintain a vendor scorecard system tracking quality, pricing, and responsiveness.
* Maintain a healthy vendor pipeline/backup options to avoid dependency on a single source.



  





**Process Integrity \& Compliance** 



* Ensure procurement is conducted with full honesty and transparency — competitive quotes, documented approvals, and clear conflict\-of\-interest policies.
* Maintain proper documentation for purchase orders, invoices, and contracts.
* Put in place checks and approval workflows that prevent misuse, kickbacks, or unauthorised purchases.
* Ensure compliance with company policy and relevant local regulations.



**Quality Assurance** 



* Design and run quality audit and testing protocols for incoming goods (linen, amenities, F\&B supplies, maintenance materials, etc.) before they reach properties.
* Conduct periodic vendor site audits to verify hygiene, storage, and quality standards.
* Set up a sampling/inspection process and escalation path for any quality deviations.



  





**Inventory \& Warehouse Management** 



* Oversee stock levels, reordering thresholds, and wastage control at the warehouse.
* Ensure proper warehouse organisation, storage standards, and safety practices.
* Coordinate with the rider team to ensure timely, accurate deliveries to properties, tracking delivery SLAs.



  





**Data, Analysis \& Reporting** 



* Track procurement spend, cost savings, vendor performance, and inventory metrics.
* Build regular dashboards/reports for management covering budget vs. actuals, category\-wise spend, and quality metrics.



  





**Cross\-functional Coordination** 



* Work with operations teams across locations (Goa, Alibaug, Lonavala, Coonoor, Srinagar, Mussoorie) to forecast procurement needs.
* Partner with finance on budgeting, invoicing, and payment cycles.
* Liaise with corporate team members in Mumbai and Goa to align on priorities.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* Strong vendor negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Proven people management and team leadership abilities.
* Analytical skills — comfortable working with spend data, dashboards, and reports (Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with procurement/ERP tools like Zoho, Tally, or SAP Ariba is a plus).
* Strong sense of ethics and integrity in handling procurement decisions.
* Working knowledge of quality control/audit processes.
* Logistics and inventory management understanding.
* Problem\-solving skills with a methodical, structured approach.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-location teams and vendors simultaneously.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and self\-driven.

description:
**Job Title** 
 : Controller (Assistant Manager)
   

  

**Department:** 
 Wealth Management – Operations (Equity Option Derivatives)
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 The Wealth Management (WM) – Derivatives Operations team is responsible for the end\-to\-end lifecycle management of Equity Derivatives. This includes processing complex trade types such as OTC Equity, Bonds, Index, Listed, and Exotic Options, as well as Swaps. The function is critical in ensuring trade accuracy, regulatory compliance, and seamless settlement processes to support the bank’s trading activities and client requirements.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The Controller is responsible for the accurate processing and lifecycle management of derivative instruments. The role focuses on maintaining the integrity of bank and client positions, ensuring strict adherence to the operational permanent control framework, and managing the reconciliation of cash and securities. The Controller acts as a key liaison between dealers, counterparties, and the Front Office to resolve discrepancies and mitigate operational risk.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**
* Execute the accurate and timely processing of OTC Equity, Bond, Index, Listed, and Exotic Options and Swap trades, ensuring continuity during public holidays.
* Maintain and update trade data in the Olympic system to ensure both bank and client positions are accurately reflected.
* Verify and authorize cash settlement instructions to Nostro banks, ensuring timely settlement and managing all related cash outflows.
* Liaise actively with dealers, counterparties, and the Front Office to identify and resolve trade discrepancies promptly.
* Review, sign, and manage transaction supplements, counterparty confirmations, and manual client advice; proactively monitor and follow up on non\-receipt of confirmations.
* Investigate and resolve Nostro and securities reconciliation breaks, including the pursuit of necessary interest claims.
* Strictly adhere to internal procedures, control measures, and regulatory requirements. Monitor and report error trades to management and ensure the formal receipt of incident reports.
* Ensure all spread charges remain within the monetary limits stipulated in the “Disclosure of Sales Related Information” and obtain formal management approval for any special waivers.
* Review daily control reports, monitor late or failed trades, and provide regular updates to Management to mitigate operational impact.
* Serve as a point of contact for queries from the Front Office, Advisory Desks, and counterparties to ensure smooth functional operations.
* Systematically update and maintain the database worksheets for all option trades.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Contribute to the implementation of operational permanent control policies and procedures in day\-to\-day business activities.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements and support ad hoc projects as required by management.
* Identify and contribute to workflow improvements to enhance operational efficiency and mitigate risk.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Minimum 7–8 years of experience in Derivatives Operations or a similar control\-oriented role.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Management, or a related field.
* Prior experience in Equity Derivatives or OTC markets is highly preferred.


**Technical Skills**
* In\-depth knowledge of Equity, Bond, and Derivative products (Options/Swaps).
* Proficiency in trade lifecycle management and settlement processes.
* Strong understanding of reconciliation, Nostro management, and control frameworks.


**Behavioral Skills**
* High level of meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for stakeholder management.
* Proactive mindset with a focus on risk mitigation and operational excellence.

 : Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

 Mumbai

**Business Head (P\&L Owner), Industrial Equipment Manufacturing** 




  





 We're hiring a Business Head to run a ₹150\+ crore P\&L for a market\-leading Indian industrial Equipment manufacturer — one that competes with, and wins against, global MNCs.

**Central COE \| Founder's Office**

 **business\-facing, problem\-solving role** 
 , not a reporting role. You'll bring together account performance, delivery, commercial and client data to answer three questions:
 **What is happening? Why is it happening? What should we do about it?** 




 You'll work closely with commercial, delivery, capability and finance leaders and be measured on business outcomes — not the number of reports produced.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 


* Build a live intelligence layer combining
 **account, delivery, commercial and client signals** 
 .

 **account risks, retention opportunities and growth opportunities** 
 early.
* Diagnose underperforming accounts and recommend specific actions to improve them.
* Work directly with business leaders to answer critical questions and influence decisions.
* Own data definitions and reconciliation to ensure the business has a
 **single source of truth** 
 .
* Bring together commercial, delivery, SEO/GEO and margin data to understand account performance end\-to\-end.

 What We're Looking For
 


* **3–6 years** 
 in BI, performance analytics, business operations, strategy or consulting.
* Strong business\-facing analytical skills and comfort working with senior stakeholders.
* Strong
 **Excel and SQL** 
 skills.
* Comfortable working with AI and automation tools such as
 **Claude, Claude Code, Lovable and n8n** 
 .
* Able to work with
 **unstructured data** 
 such as calls, decks and written commentary.
* Familiarity with
 **SEO/web analytics tools** 
 such as Ahrefs, Semrush, GA4 and Google Search Console is a strong plus.
* Strong first\-principles problem solving — able to go from
 **data → diagnosis → action** 
 .
* Comfortable challenging assumptions and communicating findings clearly.
* Digital, content, SEO or e\-commerce services experience is a strong advantage.



  





 Why This Role?
 


* Build the
 **intelligence layer for the business from the ground up** 
 .
* Work directly with the
 **Founder's Office and senior leadership** 
 .
* Influence both
 **commercial performance and client outcomes** 
 .
* Define the metrics and systems rather than inherit them.
* Strong opportunity to grow into
 **business and strategy leadership** 
 as Pepper scales.

title: Interior Contracting Purchase Manager

**Company Description**

Ltd. is an ISO 9002 certified interior contracting firm operating across thirteen states in India, with strong presence in the domestic and commercial markets for over a decade. The company focuses on delivering comprehensive post\-design interior solutions under one roof, emphasizing spaces that reflect each client’s unique ideology and brand. Interex specializes in turnkey projects for commercial complexes, financial institutions, hotels and restaurants, call centers, retail stores, and corporate offices. A multidisciplinary team manages services such as gypsum work, partitions, carpentry, plumbing, electrical work, air conditioning, painting, polishing, and civil work. * Proficiency in procurement and vendor management, including sourcing, negotiation, and purchase order processing.
